compliance-center.title: Compliance center
compliance-center.subtitle: Tools to help you meet your privacy duties: the laws you work under, who people can reach, your notices and sub-processors, and a checklist of what is in place. They do not make a workspace compliant by themselves, and this is not legal advice.
compliance-center.readOnly: You can read this page but not change it.
compliance-center.conflict: Someone else saved these settings while you were editing. The latest version is loaded; check it and make your change again.

saveBar.problems: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.
errors.settingsInvalid: Some of the settings are not valid. Check the quiet hours, the calling window, the time zone and the language.
errors.duplicate: You already list a sub-processor with that name.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the values are not valid. Check the form and try again.

problems.httpsOnly: Use an address that starts with https://.
problems.quietEmpty: The quiet hours need an end that is different from the start.
problems.windowOrder: The calling window must end after it starts, on the same day.
problems.englishFirst: English is always the first notice. Pick another language.

phi.title: Do not store protected health information.
phi.body: This product is not built for health records. We do not claim HIPAA compliance and we do not sign business associate agreements, so do not put diagnoses, treatment details, insurance numbers or similar health information in contacts, notes, messages, files, forms or recordings.

checklist.intro: What is in place in your workspace today, worked out from your own settings and data. "Built" means the tool is set up. It does not mean a law is satisfied.
checklist.baselineHint: A strict set of points we offer to all workspaces, in any country.
checklist.profileTitle: Asked for by the laws you switched on
checklist.profileHint: Each row names the profiles that ask for it. The strictest rule is used when several apply.
checklist.noProfiles: No law or region is switched on yet, so only the points for every workspace are shown. Choose them under Laws and regions.
checklist.disclaimer: This list helps you track your own setup. It is not legal advice and it does not say your workspace complies with any law. Ask your counsel what applies to you.

detail.built: Every consent is recorded against a purpose, with who or what recorded it, the wording shown, its version and the time. Nothing for you to set up.

detail.detectionOff: STOP detection is off, so a contact who replies STOP is not opted out. Switch it on in the consent settings.
detail.optInOff: STOP works, but marketing does not need a recorded consent yet. Switch on "require recorded consent" in the consent settings.
detail.built: STOP is detected and marketing needs a recorded consent.
{lines, plural, one {# consent notice is} other {# consent notices are}} switched on, including your default notice in {languages, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}}.
detail.noDefault: {lines, plural, one {# consent notice is} other {# consent notices are}} switched on, but the workspace has no default notice yet.
detail.none: No consent notice is switched on. Write a default notice so a record can name the wording a person saw.

detail.overdue: {overdue, plural, one {# request is} other {# requests are}} past the deadline, out of {open} open. Answer them in Data requests.
detail.noContact: Requests have a deadline of {days} days, but no privacy contact is named yet. Add one.
detail.built: Requests have a deadline of {days} days and {open} are open. A privacy contact is named.

detail.recordingsOn: Call recordings are kept for {days} days and can be put on hold. Retention for other data is not built yet.
detail.recordingsOff: Call recording is off. A retention setting for the rest of your data is not built yet.

detail.runbook: Workspace isolation, encrypted credentials and an audit log are in place. The breach response plan is a draft that the platform operator completes. You cannot switch this on here.

detail.built: {count, plural, one {# sub-processor is} other {# sub-processors are}} listed. The DPA template is ready to download.
detail.none: No sub-processor is listed yet. List the vendors that handle personal data for you.

detail.unset: Not answered yet. Say whether minors may be among your contacts.
detail.minorsNoParental: Minors may be included, but parental consent is not switched on.
detail.no_minors: You do not knowingly process the data of minors.
detail.may_include_minors: Minors may be included and parental consent is switched on.

detail.built: The privacy and terms links and a reachable contact are set.
detail.none: No privacy link, no terms link and no contact yet.
detail.some: Some of the links and contact details are set. Complete the rest.

dpo_contact.title: Data protection officer or privacy contact

detail.built: A name and an email are set.
detail.one: Add both a name and an email.
detail.none: No officer or privacy contact is named yet.

detail.built: A name and an email are set.
detail.one: Add both a name and an email.
detail.none: No grievance officer is named yet.

notice_languages.title: Notice in English and a second language

detail.built: Your default notice is on in English and in {locale}.
detail.noSecond: Choose the second language, then write the notice in it.
detail.secondMissing: English is on. Write the notice in the second language.
detail.englishMissing: The second language is on. Write the English notice.

detail.unset: Answer the children question under Contacts and children.
detail.minorsNoParental: Minors may be included, but parental consent is off. This profile treats anyone under {age} as a minor.
detail.no_minors: You do not knowingly process the data of minors. This profile treats anyone under {age} as a minor.
detail.may_include_minors: Parental consent is switched on for people under {age}. Keeping the evidence per contact is not built yet.

opt_out_notice.title: Do Not Sell or Share option

detail.built: The opt-out option and the link to its notice are set.
detail.noUrl: The option is on, but no link to the opt-out notice is set.
detail.off: Switch the option on if you sell or share personal information, and add the link to your opt-out notice.

detail.built: A calling window of {start} to {end} is saved.

detail.hookOnly: Registry noted ({registry}). Nothing is checked against it yet.

detail.built: All {count, plural, one {# sub-processor has} other {# sub-processors have}} a location.
detail.some: {missing, plural, one {# sub-processor has} other {# sub-processors have}} no location yet.
detail.none: No sub-processor is listed, or none has a location.

detail.built: Your deadline for requests is {sla} days, within the {days} days the strictest profile asks for.
detail.tooLong: Your deadline is {sla} days. The strictest profile you switched on asks for {days}. Change it in Data requests.

detail.off: Marketing does not need a recorded consent yet. Switch it on in the consent settings.

windows_enforcement.title: Quiet hours and calling windows are enforced

detail.enforced: Marketing messages inside your quiet hours are held until they end, and a call outside your calling window is refused with the time it opens. Replies inside the 24-hour window and utility notices are never held. The DND registry is a note: nothing is checked against it yet.

profiles.intro: Switch on the laws and regions that apply to the people you contact. You can switch on several; where they differ, the strictest rule is used. A country only suggests; you decide.
profiles.suggestedNote: A workspace that contacts people in other countries should switch on those laws too.
profiles.notConfirmed: Nothing is switched on yet. The baseline for every workspace applies until you save a choice.

gdpr_eu.name: GDPR (EU and EEA)
gdpr_eu.summary: For people in the European Union, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.
gdpr_eu.extras: A data protection officer or privacy contact, sub-processor locations, answers to requests within 30 days, recorded opt-in for marketing.

uk_gdpr.name: UK GDPR and PECR (United Kingdom)
uk_gdpr.summary: For people in the United Kingdom.
uk_gdpr.extras: A data protection officer or privacy contact, sub-processor locations, answers within 30 days, recorded opt-in for electronic marketing.

dpdp_in.name: DPDP Act (India)
dpdp_in.extras: A grievance officer, notices in English and one Indian language, a parental consent flag for minors under 18, a consent manager placeholder, recorded opt-in.

ccpa_us.name: CCPA and CPRA (United States)
ccpa_us.summary: For California residents, and a sensible start for the United States.
ccpa_us.extras: A Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information option with an opt-out notice link, answers within 45 days.

tcpa_us.name: TCPA (calls and texts to the United States)
tcpa_us.summary: For marketing calls and texts to people in the United States.
tcpa_us.extras: Quiet hours 21:00 to 08:00, a calling window 08:00 to 21:00, a Do Not Call registry note, recorded opt-in.

trai_in.name: TRAI rules (calls and texts to India)
trai_in.summary: For promotional calls and texts to people in India.
trai_in.extras: Quiet hours 21:00 to 09:00, a calling window 09:00 to 21:00, a DND registry note, recorded opt-in.

lgpd_br.name: LGPD (Brazil)
lgpd_br.extras: A data protection officer (encarregado) contact, sub-processor locations, answers within 15 days, recorded opt-in.

pdpa_sg.name: PDPA (Singapore)
pdpa_sg.extras: A data protection officer contact, a Do Not Call registry note, answers within 30 days, recorded opt-in.

generic.name: Other countries (baseline only)
generic.summary: For everywhere else, or when you have not decided.
generic.extras: Nothing beyond the baseline that every workspace already gets.

effective.title: What the strictest rule asks for
effective.hint: Worked out from the laws you switched on. These are starting points to check with your counsel.
effective.baselineOnly: No law is switched on. Only the baseline for every workspace applies.
effective.requestDays: Time to answer a person's request
effective.minorAge: Treat a person as a minor under
effective.strictest: When several profiles are on, the strictest rule is used: the shortest answer time, the highest age, the narrowest calling window.

ccpa.title: Do Not Sell or Share
ccpa.hint: If you sell or share personal information (including for advertising across other sites), people can ask you to stop.
ccpa.offer: Offer a Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information option
ccpa.urlHint: The page where people can opt out. Must start with https://.

dpdp.title: Consent manager
dpdp.hint: The DPDP Act lets people manage consent through a registered consent manager. Name yours here if you use one.
dpdp.placeholderNote: This is a note only. Nothing is connected to a consent manager yet.

contacts.intro: Who a person or a regulator can reach about their data, and whether children may be among your contacts.
contacts.requiredByProfile: Asked for by a profile you switched on

dpo.title: Data protection officer or privacy contact
dpo.hint: The person or team that answers privacy questions. Shown on your public page if you switch it on.

grievance.title: Grievance officer
grievance.hint: The DPDP Act asks for a named officer who handles complaints about how personal data is processed.

children.title: Children's data
children.hint: This product is for businesses. Say whether you may hold the data of minors, so the right rules are shown.

policies.no_minors: We do not knowingly process the data of minors
policies.may_include_minors: Minors may be among our contacts

children.parental: Parental consent is required for minors
children.parentalHint: A flag that records your policy. Collecting and keeping parental consent evidence per contact is not built yet.
children.age: The profiles you switched on treat anyone under {age} as a minor.
children.dpdpNeedsAnswer: The DPDP profile asks you to answer this question.

links.intro: Store your privacy and terms links once. They are offered with one click in the form builder's consent line and in every consent notice editor.
links.offered: Nothing is filled in by itself: each form or notice shows a button to use these links.

notices.intro: The default wording your workspace shows next to a consent box. Every change is saved as a new numbered version, so a record can name the exact text a person agreed to.

second.title: Second language
second.requiredByProfile: Asked for by the DPDP profile
second.hint: The DPDP Act asks for the notice in English and in one of India's languages. Choose the second language and save, then write the notice in it.
second.saveFirst: Save your changes first, then the notice editor for this language appears.

windows.enforcedNote: Quiet hours hold a marketing message until they end, and the calling window refuses a call outside it. Each contact's own clock is used. Replies inside the 24-hour window and utility notices are never held.
windows.intro: Some rules limit when marketing messages and calls may reach people. Set your hours here: a marketing message sent in the quiet hours waits and goes when they end, and a call outside the calling window is not placed.

quiet.title: Quiet hours for messages
quiet.hint: Hours in which marketing messages do not go out. They wait, and are sent when the hours end. The period may cross midnight.

calling.title: Calling window
calling.hint: The only hours marketing calls are placed, on the days you pick. A call outside them is refused, and says when the window opens.

windows.suggested: The laws you switched on suggest {start} to {end}.

zone.label: Fallback time zone
zone.hint: The hours are read on the contact's own clock: their time zone property, else the country code of their number. This zone is used when neither is known. Your workspace zone is {zone}.

dnd.label: Do Not Call / DND registry
dnd.hint: The registry you check your lists against.
dnd.note: This is a note only. Nothing is checked against a registry yet.

subprocessors.intro: The vendors that process personal data for your workspace: what they do, what data they get and where. You can publish the list on a public page.

empty.title: No sub-processors yet
empty.body: Add each vendor that handles personal data for you, for example your email or SMS provider.

public.title: Public page
public.hint: Publish the vendors in use, your privacy and terms links and your privacy contact on a page anyone can open. Off by default.
public.saveToApply: Save your changes to apply this.

dpa.title: Data processing agreement template
dpa.hint: A template filled in with your details and your list. It is not legal advice and not an agreement: have your counsel review it before use.

form.name: Name
form.locationHint: Country or region where they process the data.
form.httpsOnly: Use an address that starts with https://.
form.noticeHint: The day you told your customers about this vendor.

confirmRemove.title: Remove this sub-processor?
confirmRemove.body: {name} will be taken off your list. Mark it as no longer used instead if you want to keep the history.

trust.title: {workspace}: sub-processors and privacy
trust.intro: The vendors this business uses to process personal data, and how to reach its privacy contact.
